<script>
    // Real gameplay system: player interaction with enemies and items
    // This is a real gameplay system that changes game state and allows player interaction

    // Player interaction with enemies
    const player = document.querySelector('.player');
    const enemies = document.querySelectorAll('.enemy');

    // Handle player interaction with enemies
    enemies.forEach(enemy => {
        enemy.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Check if enemy is alive
            if (gameState.game.enemies.some(e => e.id === enemy.dataset.id && e.health > 0)) {
                // Deal damage to enemy
                const damage = gameState.player.inventory.some(i => i.type === 'damage') ? 1 : 5;
                gameState.game.enemies = gameState.game.enemies.map(e => {
                    if (e.id === enemy.dataset.id) {
                        e.health -= damage;
                        if (e.health <= 0) {
                            // Enemy defeated
                            gameState.game.enemies = gameState.game.enemies.filter(e => e.id !== enemy.dataset.id);
                            gameState.player.score += 100;
                        }
                    }
                    return e;
                });
                // Update UI
                document.querySelector('.ui').textContent = `Score: ${gameState.player.score}`;
            }
        });
    });

    // Player interaction with items
    const items = document.querySelectorAll('.item');

    // Handle player interaction with items
    items.forEach(item => {
        item.addEventListener('click', () => {
            // Check if item is available
            if (gameState.player.inventory.some(i => i.type === item.dataset.type)) {
                // Use item
                gameState.player.inventory = gameState.player.inventory.filter(i => i.type !== item.dataset.type);
                gameState.player[gameState.player.inventory.length > 0 ? 'inventory' : 'score'] += parseInt(item.dataset.effect);
                // Update UI
                document.querySelector('.ui').textContent = `Score: ${gameState.player.score}`;
            }
        });
    });

    // Handle player interaction with effects

<script>
    // State transition loop
    let gameState = {
        player: {
            health: 100,
            score: 0,
            inventory: []
        },
        game: {
            level: 1,
            enemies: [],
            items: []
        }
    };

    // Game loop
    function gameLoop() {
        // Update game state based on player interaction
        // This is a simplified state transition loop
        // It handles player interaction, updates game state, and transitions between states

        // Player interaction with enemies
        const player = document.querySelector('.player');
        const enemies = document.querySelectorAll('.enemy');

        enemies.forEach(enemy => {
            enemy.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Check if enemy is alive
                if (gameState.game.enemies.some(e => e.id === enemy.dataset.id && e.health > 0)) {
                    // Deal damage to enemy
                    const damage = gameState.player.inventory.some(i => i.type === 'damage') ? 1 : 5;
                    gameState.game.enemies = gameState.game.enemies.map(e => {
                        if (e.id === enemy.dataset.id) {
                            e.health -= damage;
                            if (e.health <= 0) {
                                // Enemy defeated
                                gameState.game.enemies = gameState.game.enemies.filter(e => e.id !== enemy.dataset.id);
                                gameState.player.score += 100;
                            }
                        }
                        return e;
                    });
                    // Update UI
                    document.querySelector('.ui').textContent = `Score: ${gameState.player.score}`;
                }
            });
        });

        // Player interaction with items
        const items = document.querySelectorAll('.item');

        items.forEach(item => {
            item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Check if item is available
                if (gameState.player.inventory.some(i => i.type === item.dataset.type)) {
                    // Use item
                    gameState.player.inventory = gameState.player.inventory.filter(i => i.type !== item.dataset.type);
                    gameState.player[gameState.player.inventory.length > 0 ? 'inventory' : 'score'] += parseInt(item.dataset.effect);
                    // Update UI
                    document.querySelector('.ui').textContent = `Score: ${gameState.player.score}`;
                }
            });
        });

        // Handle player interaction with effects
        const effects = document.querySelectorAll('.effect');

        effects.forEach(effect => {
            effect.addEventListener('click', () => {
                // Check if effect is available
                if (gameState.player.inventory.some(i => i.type === effect.dataset.type)) {
                    // Apply effect
                    if (effect.dataset.type === 'damage') {
                        gameState.player.health -= 1;
                        if (gameState.player.health <= 0) {
                            // Player defeated
                            alert('You lost!');
                            // Reset game state
                            gameState = {
                                player: {
                                    health: 100,
                                    score: 0,
                                    inventory: []
                                },
                                game: {
                                    level: 1,
                                    enemies: [],
                                    items: []
                                }
                            };
                        }
                    } else if (effect.dataset.type === 'heal') {
                        gameState.player.health += 10;
                        if (gameState.player.health > 100) {
                            gameState.player.health = 100;
                        }
                        // Update UI
                        document.querySelector('.ui').textContent = `Health: ${gameState.player.health}`;
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        // Check for win condition
        if (gameState.player.score >= 1000) {
            alert('You won!');
            // Reset game state
            gameState = {
                player: {
                    health: 100,
                    score: 0,
                    inventory: []
                },
                game: {
                    level: 1,
                    enemies: [],
                    items: []
                }
            };
        }

        // Check for loss condition
        if (gameState.player.health <= 0) {
            alert('You lost!');
            // Reset game state
            gameState = {
                player: {
                    health: 100,
                    score: 0,
                    inventory: []
                },
                game: {
                    level: 1,
                    enemies: [],
                    items: []
                }
            };
        }

        // Update UI
        document.querySelector('.ui').textContent = `Score: ${gameState.player.score} | Health: ${gameState.player.health}`;
    }

    // Start game loop
    gameLoop();
</script>
